checks.quote: depletion-reagent sequences
checks.reason: Actual acute system, preparation/delivery and assay quantities remain unselected; calibration intentions do not yield an executable engineering and assay workflow.

checks.quote: lost to tracking gaps
checks.reason: Lost tracks are counted in a flow diagram but excluded without an explicit unknown-fate bound or informative-loss sensitivity analysis; balanced overall completeness is insufficient.

checks.quote: uncertainty intervals
checks.reason: No actual multiplicity/gatekeeping procedure for necessity/rescue and no formal equivalence procedure for restoration to the intact response.

checks.quote: before differential arrest
checks.reason: Before arrest is not necessarily before differential repair. Genotype-dependent marker changes need not prove marker invalidity, and retitration can match away p53-mediated repair instead of matching initial injury.

checks.quote: small concentration and time grid
checks.reason: No quantitative bounds or procedure deriving the bounded damage/caffeine exploration before locking.

checks.quote: moving toward
checks.reason: A significant partial loss and rescue moving toward the intact state do not demonstrate negligible residual depleted arrest and intact-equivalent restoration required for the stated necessity/restoration claim.
